package.author: TwintailTeam
package.description: A multi-platform launcher for your anime games

en-US.author: TwintailTeam
en-US.description: A multi-platform launcher for your anime games
en-US.longDescription: Twintaillauncher is a multi-platform launcher that brings mod support, quality-of-life improvements, and advanced features to a variety of anime-styled games.
en-US.name: twintaillauncher
en-US.releaseNotes:
Games
- Fix issue with Wuthering Waves updates due to deprecated api and upgrade handling to handle new api
- Fix Zenless Zone Zero repair being broken due multi manifest system causing deletion of valid game files
- Fix Wuthering Waves having same broken repair issue like Zenless Zone Zero from above due to new api changes
Bug fixes and optimizations
- Fix issues with proton wineland being recognized as wine in the system lol
- Fix some issues with windows shortcuts for names containing illegal characters
- Fix a crash for when runner manifests repo could not be initialized
